newsitem.title: DUBAI: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - July 15.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - July 15.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the United Arab Emirates (UAE) press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Ground improvement work, first in a series of civil works to be undertaken at the $2 billion LNG plant in Sur in Oman, was completed last month, nine weeks before schedule.
- An appeal against a four-year jail term imposed on a 25-year-old Australian woman by a Sharjah court for alleged drug-related offences has been adjourned until July 28.
- UAE cabinet sets up panel to study fisheries.
- Sharjah Electricity and Water Authority has appealed to the public not drink water supplied by a desalination plant affected by a diesel spill on Friday.
- A group of Arab and other investors has launched a company with a capital of $92 million to target unlisted Middle East equities and regional stock markets.
- Saudi deficit seen low despite high spending.
- The number of British companies operating in Dubai's Jebel Ali Free Zone is expected to increase this year.
- Abu Dhabi set to spend 1.5 billion dirhams ($409 million) on maintenace and expansion of airport runways.
